title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・輝き、揺らめいて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her frustration at losing the spring Tenno Sho, Mejiro Bright vows to keep trying. Her persistence makes Mejiro Dober see a strength in her friend that she doesn't have herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober feels a pull to become like Mejiro Bright, but then she realizes she's always been focused on becoming someone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Because she has no confidence in herself, she's been chasing after others. But everyone she sees as shining was able to succeed because they were resolved to do things their own way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having come to this conclusion, Mejiro Dober decides she must confront her own weaknesses if she wants to forge a new Mejiro legacy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her goal is no longer to become like anyone else but to become truly strong as Mejiro Dober! Her mind made up, she begins preparing for the Takarazuka Kinen.
